description: Resolve a coin name or ticker symbol to a CoinGecko ID (slug). The required first step before any ID-keyed tool — CoinGecko keys data by slug (bitcoin, ethereum), not ticker (BTC, ETH), and tickers are not unique (many coins share ETH/USDC). Returns ranked matches with id, symbol, name, and market_cap_rank to disambiguate; pick the intended coin from the ranked candidates.

query.description: Coin name or ticker symbol to resolve (e.g. "bitcoin", "ETH", "solana").

name: coingecko_search_coins

cap.description: The cap applied to the candidate list. Present only when capped.

coins.description: Ranked slug candidates (top 25 by relevance). Data provided by CoinGecko.

id.description: CoinGecko slug — the id to chain into every other tool (e.g. "ethereum").

marketCapRank.description: Market-cap rank when known — lower is larger; aids disambiguation. Omitted when unranked.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol (not unique across coins; e.g. "eth").

thumb.description: Thumbnail icon URL when provided by upstream.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched — echoes the query and suggests how to broaden.

shown.description: Number of candidates returned. Present only when capped.

truncated.description: True when the candidate list was capped at the limit. Present only when capped.

title: coingecko-mcp-server: search coins
